lesson_title: Testing & CI — Unit, Integration, and Workflow Automation

questions.question: Why does this Jest test always pass even when the function returns the wrong value?
options: The test expectation is incorrect — it's asserting the wrong value; fix expected toBe(3)
Jest automatically mocks numbers so the assertion is ignored
add() must be async for tests to work
toBe compares objects and always returns true for numbers

questions.question: Which test type verifies the interaction between components and external systems like a database?
options: Integration tests
Unit tests
Smoke tests
Static analysis

questions.question: Why is this API integration test flaky?
options: The test does not wait for the server to be fully started before running requests — return/await the start promise or use setup hooks properly
HTTP calls must be mocked always
afterAll should be beforeAll
Integration tests cannot use beforeAll

questions.question: Which of these best describes continuous integration (CI)?
options: Automatically building and testing code on each change to detect regressions early
Deploying to production on every commit without tests
Manually running tests before every pull request
Storing test data in version control

questions.question: Why does this mock not intercept the database call in the module under test?
options: Module under test imports db before jest.mock runs — mock must be hoisted or use jest.mock at top-level before importing the module
db.query cannot be mocked in Jest
jest.mock only works with ES modules
Mocks must be replaced with sinon

questions.question: Which practice reduces test suite runtime for fast feedback?
options: Parallelizing tests and only running changed tests in CI
Running full integration tests on every local save
Adding more end-to-end tests for every component
Disabling assertions in CI

questions.question: Why does this snapshot test fail on minor changes like whitespace?
options: Snapshot tests are brittle — they capture full render output; focus snapshots on meaningful parts or update snapshots intentionally
Snapshots must be stored in the database
toMatchSnapshot only works with numbers
You must stringify output before snapshotting

questions.question: What is a good use-case for end-to-end (E2E) tests like Cypress?
options: Verify critical user journeys across the entire stack (login, purchase flow)
Replace all unit tests
Speed up local development
Automatically generate API docs

questions.question: Why does this CI job fail on secrets access but succeed locally?
questions.code: // CI logs show missing env var DB_PASSWORD
options: CI environment variables must be configured in the pipeline settings — avoid committing secrets; use the CI provider's secret store
Local machines always have access to secrets
You must hardcode secrets in .env for CI
CI cannot run database migrations

questions.question: Which tool is commonly used for running tests and generating coverage in Node.js projects?
options: Jest
Gulp
Webpack
Sass
